mc_output_definitions.m: order parameter vector (1/n) sum e_i over the spins of the set (n = number of spins in the set); for "A-minus-B", (1/n_total)(sum_A e_i - sum_B e_i)
mc_output_definitions.m2_kmin_per_sample: <|m(k)|^2> of the total magnetization, m(k) = (1/n) sum_i e_i exp(i k.r_i), averaged over the three smallest nonzero wave vectors k = 2 pi / box_A[d] along x, y and z
mc_output_definitions.m2_per_sample, m4_per_sample, abs_m_per_: thermal averages <|m|^2>, <|m|^4>, <|m|> per sample (rows) and temperature (columns)
